description: Source code for analyzing and generating data related to PyTorch operations, including functions for retrieving operation info, categorizing operations, and generating batching rule data.

methods.name: get_ops_for_key
methods.description: Retrieves registered operations for a given dispatch key from PyTorch's C++ backend.

methods.name: gen_data
methods.description: Generates operation data, categorizes operations, and writes analysis to a file.

methods.name: name_check
methods.description: Returns a lambda function to check if an operation's name is in a list.

methods.name: full_name_check
methods.description: Returns a lambda function to check if an operation's full name is in a list.

methods.name: count_fn
methods.description: Returns the count of an operation based on preloaded operation counts.

methods.name: has_ref_impl
methods.description: Checks if an operation has a reference implementation in the public API.
